actions.name: click
actions.description: A click at x, y, or at the middle of a control named by "node", a path from "ui". The pointer moves there first and stays, as a player's would. "button" is left (the default), right or middle.

actions.name: drag
actions.description: Presses the left button at x, y, or at the middle of "node", moves the pointer to to_x, to_y over a few frames and releases it there. Time stays still during the drag.

actions.name: hover
actions.description: Rests the pointer at x, y, or at the middle of a control named by "node", until a tooltip opens; last_action.tooltip holds its lines, and the next image shows it.

actions.name: key
actions.description: Presses and releases a key, named as Godot names it, such as Space, Escape, A or F1.

actions.name: hold
actions.description: Holds keys down, such as ["W", "D"], while game time runs for "seconds" (at most 10), then releases them. Its wait runs after the release.

actions.name: wait
actions.description: Only lets time run: its wait, or 1 second without one.
